senses.gloss: m. (a Babylonian corrupt. of parangaria, v. פַּרְהַנְגַּרְיָא) the office of public service, sub. בעל the suprintendent of public labors, in gen. tax collector.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:17">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>מסרה לפרהגב׳ דמלכא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>פַּרְהַגְנָא</he>; Ms. H. <he>פרהגמוניא</he>; Ms. R. <cite ref="Q01604"><he>פַּרְהַנְגָּא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he surrendered it (the object of litigation) to the royal office (or officer, for confiscation).

<cite ref="Eruvin 36b:9">Erub. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>הא בפ׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Sonc. <he>בפרח גבאני דמלכא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100; Rashi <he>בפרהגבני</he>) in the one case the officer of public service is meant (by <he>נכרים</he>), in the other, the town officers.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:5">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>אשכח לההוא פ׳ דמלכא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="Q01601"><he>פרהגונא</he></cite> only) he met the royal officer who was seizing thieves (persons without regular occupations) for the public service; cmp. <cite ref="A02105"><he>אַנְּגְּרַבְטֵיס</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01601"><he>פַּרְהֲגַבְנֵי</he></cite>, v. supra.
